messages:
PR-Bot: New PR opened #4721 by @maria — "monitoring + sdk: add new metrics" (https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4721)
Maria L.: hey eng-platform — this PR touches infra/monitoring/alerts.yaml AND sdk/client/api.go. not sure who needs to sign off. pinging here bc CODEOWNERS is a bit fuzzy for multi-area changes.
Maria L.: short question — who can approve/merge something that hits both infra and SDK?
Devin H.: @Maria L. generally each area needs at least one approver. infra => eng-platform, sdk => sdk-maintainers. for a single PR that touches both, you need approvals from both teams unless we add an exception.
Samir P.: quick check of CODEOWNERS:
```
/infra/ @eng-platform
/sdk/ @sdk-maintainers
```
So the file routes to both teams, but branch protection requires 2 approvals so that fits.
Samir P.: problem is sometimes people assume "eng-platform can approve everything" — that's not correct for SDK code.
Lee (eng-platform): I can take the infra side once CI is green. we prefer separating infra and sdk changes into two PRs but i get that's not always possible. if you keep it combined, please explicitly add reviewers from both teams.
Anita K.: FYI security should look if the alerting change touches any creds or external endpoints — looks fine at a glance but tagging in case: @security.
Maria L.: thanks — splitting would be extra churn for this change (small metric + alert tweak). can we do cross-team approval this time? i'll add reviewers.
Devin H.: if you're short on time, add at least one owner from each team and mark it ready for review. ping leads if you need a fast turnaround. i can nudge SDK maintainers. :+1:
PR-Bot: CI checks completed — all green ✅
Samir P.: i've added @Lee (for infra) and @Anita K. (security) as reviewers. @Devin H. can you add someone from SDK?
Devin H.: added @alex-sdk as reviewer and set review priority to high.
Lee (eng-platform): saw it — i'll review tonight. if nothing blocking i'll approve the infra files.
Maria L.: appreciated. once both approvals in i'll merge. note to self: open a follow-up to tidy CODEOWNERS for multi-area paths so routing is clearer.
Devin H.: also consider adding a tiny OWNERS file under the affected sdk package to make future routing explicit.
Maria L.: good call. thanks everyone :heart:
